page0.text:
There's only silence.
No one could utter a sound, even I am at a loss for words.
Souichirou Kuzuki is dead.
He died on the path he chose, like a ghost who left behind no words of longing, nor feelings of regret or hope.

page1.text:
...My head hurts.
I'm not sure if it's because my stressed Magic Circuit is pressing against my nerves,
or because I can't forgive Archer for killing Kuzuki without even batting an eye, or because I'm mad at myself for being utterly powerless to oppose.
Without knowing the cause, the sharp pain in my head gets even sharper.

page2.text:
...
I turn my head towards the sound.
With Caster gone, the binding curses should be undone.
In front of the altar at the back of the church, Saber hits the floor.

page3.text:
"ah...hn..."
Still lying on the floor, Saber's breathing is labored and in pain.
Seeing her like that makes me forget about my headache.

page4.text:
"Saber...!"
I rush towards her.
I am annoyed that even the few meters between me and her feels so far away.

page5.text:
"...Shirou."
Saber looks up.
Seeing me running towards her, Saber lets out a sigh of relief...

page6.text:
"...!"
"Huh?"
She suddenly tackles me and sends me flying.

page7.text:
A sudden blow from the side, I was knocked down without resisting.
My body is sent flying and bounces hard against the floor.

page8.text:
"Ack...!"
My back lands first on the floor.
"Ugh...!"
I am still confused by what just happened, but just as I look up...
In that moment...
I hear the sound of metal clashing again.

page9.text:
"Wha..."
What I see is Saber armoring up.
...And.
Right in front of her, on the ground where I had stood, there are multiple swords piercing the floor.

page10.text:
"Tch... I missed."
It's him.
He lets out a sound of disappointment as he keeps his sight on Saber.

page11.text:
...
Not even able to stand upright, Saber glares at Archer.

page12.text:
"...The, bastard."
I don't have to guess the reason.
He fired his sword and tried to kill me from behind my back.
Saber noticed what he was trying to do and instantly covered for me.

page13.text:
"..."
Tohsaka stands there looking at him dumbfounded, while Saber wields her sword as she's gasping for breath.
Even if their positions are different, they harbor the same question:
Now that Caster is defeated, why is Archer trying to kill Shirou Emiya?

page14.text:
...
Only Archer and I stood unfazed by the interaction.
...That's right, I'm not surprised at what just happened.
We have despised each other from the very beginning.
We have stood against each other knowing we will never get along.
We both reject each other's existence, not even knowing why.

page15.text:
...Why?
The reason behind why we must reject each other—If it's really what I think it is.
Of course he would want to kill me.

page16.text:
"Argh..."
I try to stand up after being knocked to the floor.
Saber was pretty desperate.
She probably charged into me without being able to hold back. Because of that, she can barely catch her breath.

page17.text:
...That's why I must stand up.
If the Saber I knew were to tackle me, it wouldn't be this weak.
Right now she barely has enough strength to even face me.
If she's to go up against Archer in that body of hers, it would be no different than suicide.

page18.text:
"Archer, what were you thinking!?"
Tohsaka approaches Archer.
...Of course she's confused.
Archer only sided with Caster so he could betray her at the end and kill her.
Now that he's succeeded, there's no reason for Archer to attack me.

page19.text:
"Your little act is over now, right? Caster is defeated so I won't allow you to act on your own anymore!"
"Won't allow? I don't get it, why must I seek your approval to do anything? Especially when you're not my Master anymore."

page20.text:
"What...? Archer...?"
"My contract with you has ended. Now that I'm free, do you think I would choose to lower myself to be a human's lackey?"

page21.text:
...
Tohsaka looks upon Archer like she still can't believe what she's just heard, but then a sudden realization hits her.
"Don't tell me... Archer..."

page22.text:
"I only act for my own goal.
However, it'll be a bit troublesome for you to be there."
"...!"

page23.text:
Tohsaka jumps back.
She distances herself from Archer, and starts running towards me while I am still trying to stand up.
But Tohsaka was not able to do that.

page24.text:
A storm of swords two meters tall is raining down.
The swords come down in a circular pattern, stabbing the floor to create a cage.

page25.text:
"...Ugh!"
A circular cage with barely enough space for a single human.
The instant the cage is formed, Tohsaka is trapped in the middle of it.

page26.text:
"Now that I've come this far, I won't let you interfere. The contract is severed, so the Command Spell you've used on me no longer works.
That's the only reason I sided with Caster. In order to void the Command Spell you've used on me, I must also void the contract."

page27.text:
Archer starts walking, turning his back on Tohsaka who's now trapped in a cage of swords.
He's not walking towards Saber, but towards me while I still have my knee on the floor.

page28.text:
"I knew it... Why, Archer!? Are you still trying to kill Shirou!?"
"...That's right. I will kill Shirou Emiya with my own hands.
That is my only wish, the wish of a man who's fallen to become a Guardian."

page29.text:
"What?"
Strength is returning to Saber's body.
She collects her thoughts, focuses her strength, and shifts herself between Archer and myself.

page31.text:
"...That reminds me. Saber, I think you've once said to me that I don't have the pride of a hero.
Of course not. It's impossible for me to harbor such emotion. The only thing that I harbor is the feeling of regret.
...You see, Saber. I wish... I never became a hero."

page32.text:
...
Saber's will to fight is leaving her body.
...Maybe she has suddenly understood something. Whatever it may be, she no longer has any animosity towards Archer.

page33.text:
"I've said enough. Now step aside, King of Knights. You don't have a Master anymore so if you do anything reckless, you will disappear.
Shirou Emiya no longer has the right to be a Master. Your wish will not be fulfilled even if you help him."

page34.text:
"...I can't do that. Even if he's not a Master anymore, my pact with him still stands. I swore that I would protect him, that I would be his sword.
...He didn't know anything about the Holy Grail War, yet he has answered my one-sided wish. I cannot easily betray that trust."
She holds up her invisible sword.
But the brave and gallant knight is nowhere to be seen.

page35.text:
"...I see. In that case, you can die here along with your false lord."
Swords appear in Archer's hands.
"...Guh."
Wha...! Saber can't even withstand Archer's attack as she is right now!

page36.text:
"...You idiot, Saber, run!"
I stand up and try to reach out for Saber.
Maybe she's trying to stay away from my reach,
"Hah!"
Saber focuses all her strength to her feet and rushes toward Archer.

page37.text:
...The fight is over after a few rounds of trading blows.
The old Saber would've undoubtedly overpowered Archer, but now she can barely swing her sword for seconds before she's down on her knees.

page38.text:
...Saber doesn't even have a sword in her hand anymore.
In an effort to resist Caster's curse, she used up all of her magical energy.
For Saber now, even taking in air is an effort. She's facing down, all fours on the floor, and trying her hardest just to maintain her existence.

page39.text:
...
Archer raises his arms.
He swings his swords down upon the defenseless Saber.
I rush in,
"Haaaaaaahhhhh!"
and muster up all my strength to block Archer's attack.

page40.text:
"...!"
I hold up my two swords.
With the weapons I instantly Projected in my hand, I fix my sight on the red knight.

page41.text: "...Well, well. I thought you'd behave for a little bit longer. I guess you really can't stand a woman being killed in front of you."

page42.text:
"...Shut up. The person you really want to kill is me. Then point your swords at the right person."
The two of us continue to face off with each other.
We both hold twin swords in our hands.
Even though our stature may differ, our stance is absolutely identical.

page43.text:
"If you mimic someone long enough, eventually no one can tell you apart. However, can that body of yours withstand using this much magecraft?"
A clear mockery.
...But like he said, I am at my limit.
My headache won't stop, and my accelerated Magic Circuits are at their limit because of my repeated Projection.
...In my current state, if I continue to trade blows with him while maintaining the swords, my brain will explode before he cuts me down.

page44.text:
"...Ngh."
"I told you already, you are not fit to use Projection. Using a magecraft not fit for you will only lead to your own destruction. It seems you are paying the price for performing miracles until this point, Shirou Emiya."
Archer is charging towards me.

page45.text:
"Ngh... Shut the hell up, you piece of—"
At that moment.
I meet Archer's swords with my own, with such intensity as if it will make me forget about my headache.

page46.text:
I swing my weapons.
My movement is simply a mimicry of my opponent's.
If my swords are borrowed, so is the skill to wield them.
That's why there's no way I can match him.
Even if I'm at my peak condition, I'm not able to defeat him.

page47.text:
A fake can come close to the real thing, but it will never surpass it.
That's why I didn't have a chance to stand up to this man from the beginning.

page48.text:
He told me to drown holding on to my ideals.
He also told me my life was a lie.
...I couldn't say anything to him, because he was my ideal.
The power to realize the impossible.
A man who became a Heroic Spirit after saving so many others.
I am the one who wished to become like that.

page49.text:
That's why I can't win.
The man standing in front of me is one who has reached the end of my ideal.
If this man is truly the same person who wanted to become stronger to save others, the embodiment of Shirou Emiya's ideals...

page50.text:
"Ah...ngh...!"
The swords shattered.
While I was able to block his attack, I lost my swords in the process.

page51.text:
...My consciousness...is...fading.
My body is uninjured, but what's inside of my body is bleeding, slowly withering away…

page52.text:
"Now do you understand? This is the limit of Shirou Emiya. It is a fitting end for someone who's been pushing himself past his limits until today."
He raises his sword.
...
Just when I try to discern which side the sword is going to cut down from with my fading consciousness...

page53.text:
"Heed my words!
My will creates your body, and your sword creates my destiny! If you heed the Grail's call and obey my will and reason—"

page54.text: Tohsaka's dignified voice echoes in the church.

page55.text:
"—!"
Maybe he was distracted by that.
The sword strike loses its momentum, if that's the case...
"Gnh...hah!"
Even in my current body, I can dodge that attack!

page56.text:
I rolled away on the floor to create some distance.
"Tch!"
Archer clicks his tongue. He doesn't go after me, and looks at Saber on the floor.

page57.text:
"—Then answer me! Thus I shall place my fate by your sword!"
Tohsaka is reaching her hand out to Saber from her cage of swords.
Responding to her call, Saber rushes to Tohsaka with all her strength...

page58.text:
"Upon my name as Saber, I hereby accept your oath...!
Rin, I will acknowledge you as my Master!"
This is the contract that should've happened.
Saber is finally able to get the Master she deserves.

page59.text:
Winds gather and whirl around Saber.
Perhaps it's because she's gotten her real power back now that she has a proper Master.
The Saber facing Archer now is not the same person as before.

page60.text:
"...What is this?"
I'm not the only one stunned by this sight.
Even Archer is enchanted by what's happening.
A surge of magical energy and a set of armor that's impervious to damage.
That enormous magical energy, which is enough to overwhelm anyone, is truly infinite.
THAT is Saber.
The Heroic Spirit of the Sword that is said to be the most powerful of Servants!

page61.text:
"...Tch. I'd intended to have her forge another contract with Rin, but this isn't quite how I thought it would go."
Maybe he can't spare any effort on me anymore, but Archer is only focusing on Saber.

page62.text:
"And? What are you going to do, Saber?
Now that you've formed a contract with Rin, what happens with Shirou Emiya going forward is irrelevant to you..."
"I have told you, Archer. My oath with Shirou stands."
Saber says with determination.
Irritated by her words, Archer grips his swords.

page63.text:
"I could ask the same of you, Archer. What are you going do? If you still want to kill Shirou, then you will have to go through me.
Now is your chance to rethink your decision. Should you go against me now, well, I am sure even you understand how slim your chances are."

page64.text:
Saber's words are true.
Saber in her condition now could go against Berserker one-on-one and still walk away victorious.
It doesn't matter who Archer is, he can't win against Saber.
He understands that better than anyone, yet...

page65.text:
"Hmph. Look at you, brimming with confidence simply because you regained some magical energy...!"
Not letting her respond, Archer charges at Saber.

page66.text:
Swords clash.
A bolt of crimson rushes toward Saber, and Archer swings with all of his might.

page67.text:
"...Hah!"
Saber blocks that attack without even flinching.
Their difference in stature and even Archer's sudden burst of speed make no difference.
Saber parries Archer's attack with ease.

page68.text:
Yet Archer is the one who falls back despite being on the offense.
A single strike with utmost power and precision...
"Hngh...ugh..."
Not only was it blocked, he even lost his balance in the process.

page69.text:
"Ngh!"
Archer falls back without hesitation.
Seeing an opening,
Saber attacks Archer with a fierce onslaught.

page70.text:
There's nothing Archer can do, other than block Saber's attacks.
If he tries to counter, Saber's sword will split his skull in that opening.

page71.text:
No, he doesn't even have the spare effort to think about countering.
The only resistance allowed for Archer is blocking Saber's attack until he runs out of strength.

page72.text:
Even then, that won't last long.
The magical energy embued in Saber's sword is chipping away at Kanshou and Bakuya.
The twin swords can't stand any more of Saber's attacks, nor does Archer have much strength left.

page73.text:
The end came sooner than expected.
Not able to withstand Saber's assault, Archer falls down on his knee.
Saber stops for a short moment, then swings down her sword.

page74.text:
That decisive strike, Archer stopped it with the cross formed by his swords.
The fight ends there.
While Archer did stop Saber's attack, he can't move another inch.
If he lets go even an ounce of his strength, Saber's sword will cut him in half from the skull down.

page75.text:
"Ngh...Hm..."
Pouring all his strength into his arms, Archer stops Saber's strike.
Sweat is dripping down Archer's forehead, and he's gasping for breath.

page76.text:
...
In contrast, Saber is calm and collected.
In close range combat, it's impossible for an Archer-class Servant to win against a Saber-class Servant.

page77.text: "This is the end for you, Archer."

page78.text:
"You were worrying about me earlier, but I shall return those words to you. With Caster gone and the rate you've been using your Noble Phantasm, you shouldn't have much magical energy left.
On top of that, you don't have a Master, an anchor to stay manifested in this world. You can't even replenish your magical energy. Just what exactly can you do in your current state now?"

page79.text:
"Hah. You don't have to worry about that, Saber.
Archer-class Servants have a unique skill that let them stay manifested independently. They can survive for at least two days even without a Master. That's plenty of time for me to kill him."

page80.text:
"Why are you still talking about that nonsense! Are you saying your wish is not for the Grail but to kill Shirou!?"
...
Archer didn't respond.
His cold eyes simply stare at the baffled and troubled Saber.

page81.text:
"...How can you wish for something like that? Archer your wish is mistaken.
Why...Why would you wish for an end like that? Even if you do something like that, you won't..."
...be saved.
Saber bites down on her lips before she can finish her sentence.

page82.text:
"...Hmph. My wish is mistaken... Huh?"
Archer puts more strength into his arms.
He stares back at Saber,
"Right back at you, Saber.
Just how long are you still going to cling on to that mistaken wish of yours?"
A brief moment of sadness flickers in Archer's eyes as he asks Saber.

page83.text:
"Archer..."
Saber's grip on her sword weakens.
"Hngh!"
Archer seizes the opportunity to free himself, and uses the opening to kick Saber off!

page84.text:
"Ugh...!"
Saber was sent backward from that kick, but she lands with grace.
The situation doesn't change from a minute ago.
A stalemate between Saber who is protecting me, and Archer who has his back turned to the caged Tohsaka.
The distance between the two has extended to about five meters.

page85.text:
"...Okay. I didn't think I could match your sword skills, but to think it would be this obvious."
The swords in his hands disappear, and he faces Saber empty-handed.

page86.text:
"...Archer, I take that gesture to be you retreating—"
"No, and I would stop your assumption. I am an Archer-class Servant. There are no archers who would prefer to fight with swords."
After saying that,

page87.text: "I am the bone of my sword."

page88.text: In a whisper, Archer starts with the incantation.

page89.text:
"Stop it, Archer! We still have—"
"Saber. One day, someone will be here to liberate you.
It seems that time has yet to arrive. But I'm sure I will be part of it the next time you are involved."

page90.text: "Unknown to death. Nor known to life."

page91.text:
The incantation echoes in the church.
...Nothing changes in the surrounding.
An incantation that long will most certainly affect the environment.
Magecraft is something that works by exerting influence on the world itself.
However, his incantation doesn't do it, but...

page92.text:
"Well, that's a topic for next time. I only have one goal right now, and that's to kill Shirou Emiya.
If you are to stand in my way... Then this world I'm creating won't hold back on destroying you."

page93.text:
He raises his left arm.
Does that mean he's completing his incantation?

page95.text: With a clear phrase, he starts to exert his influence on the world.

page96.text:
...Flames erupting.
The flames trace across the floor, as if drawing a line.
Does that mean the flames are creating a boundary around the church?
The bright luminescence generated by the flame envelops the church.
In an instant, the church was replaced by a strange landscape.

page97.text:
...
My headache is overpowering my thoughts.

page98.text:
...I can understand.
I can understand this magecraft...this bizarre scenery.
It shouldn't be possible for me to understand, but I was able to decipher what is happening in front of my eyes naturally.
And that fact...
That fact is hurting my head more than anything.

page99.text:
To sum it up in one word, this is a forge.
Burning flames and rotating gears in the sky.
Swords with no wielders are scattered across this wasteland.
Every blade across the landscape is a famed sword.
Even the Kashou and Bakuya he uses were weaved from this world.

page100.text:
A seemingly infinite Projection of weapons.
The countless weapons make this place look like a junkyard.
And standing in the middle of this wasted kingdom, is the red knight.

page101.text:
"What is...this?"
There is obvious confusion in Saber's voice.
Standing in the cold phantom flame, she looks at the red knight, bewildered.

page102.text:
"...Reality Marble.
A forbidden spell that corrodes the world by materializing someone's mental landscape over it.
That means not only were you not a swordsman nor a bowman."

page103.text:
"Yes. I was a mage before becoming a Heroic Spirit, when I was alive."
Tohsaka speaks calmly.
Does that mean...she already knew?
Maybe she has already discerned Archer's identity?

page105.text:
"I don't have anything of the sort.
That's because I never possesed any blessed swords or cursed ones. This world is the only thing I have.
If a Noble Phantasm is what represents the essence of a Heroic Spirit, then this magecraft, this Reality Marble, is my true Noble Phantasm.
As long as it categorizes as a weapon, I can replicate it and store it in this world simply by looking at the original. That is my ability as a Heroic Spirit.

page106.text:
...
Saber can't believe what she's heard.
She looks around, bewildered, seeing only swords in this wasteland, swords that feel no different than unmarked gravestones.
This place filled with wasteland and iron, covered by a lonely gray sky.

page107.text:
"Are you telling me... This is your world, Archer?"
"Indeed. Would you like to give it a try, Saber?
I will replicate your sacred sword with absolute detail."

page108.text:
"My sacred sword... Are you saying you know what it is, Archer?"
"Of course. I might not be able to perfectly replicate a sword like that, but I can make one that's close to the real thing.
What will happen then? When two sacred swords clash, do you think the bystanders will live to tell the tale?"

page109.text:
"You...! Archer, how could you!?"
"Now you're getting it. So don't go waving around that sword too much, Saber. If you unleash its power, then I will have no choice but to counter it.
If that were to happen, it wouldn't be us who would perish, but the bystanders around us.
...Knowing you, you would sacrifice yourself to protect that boy. I probably won't survive after Projecting a sacred sword.
That means only a single person, Shirou Emiya, would survive. Then everything would be for naught."

page110.text:
Archer raises his left arm.
At the signal, swords start to levitate behind him.

page111.text:
"...Don't resist.
You won't die if you're lucky. Just ask your Master to heal you after my business here is finished."
Archer's finger points at Saber.
Countless swords turn and point at Saber.
Every single one of those swords is capable of delivering a killing blow.

page112.text:
"...Feel free to dodge if you'd like. But just know the man behind you won't be so lucky."
He gives his command to the swords.

page113.text:
"......!"
The infinite amount of swords start their assault.
Saber can't afford to move a single inch from her spot.
Knowing a single mishap could be fatal, Saber grips the sword in her hand and strikes down each and every sword that rains down.

page114.text:
"...Trace, on."
My headache is taking away my ability to think.
My Magic Circuits will only last for one more try.
My devastated insides are scorched beyond recognition and on the verge of melting.
But all of that stopped mattering from the moment I saw his world.
Next thing I know, I'm focusing my strength and running up next to Saber, fixing my eyes on those annoying swords.

page115.text: "Shirou!? You can't be here, step back!"

page116.text:
Who cares?
If my eyes can't keep up with the flurry of swords, then what I need to do now is let my senses take over and analyze them.
Even if my head can't process any faster, I'm still pushing it beyond its limit.

page117.text:
The next wave of swords is coming.
It feels as if the hammer of a gun knocks down on the back of my head.

page118.text:
"Don't—"
I reach out my left arm.
I don't have a shred of doubt.
I copied so many up until now.
If the logic and the method behind what I did was correct,
"—give me that bullshit, you bastard!!!"
then there's no way I can't copy the flurry of swords before me!

page119.text:
...Fragments shatter around us.
When I opened my eyes, his Reality Marble or whatever it's called was gone.
What remain are the scattered fragments of swords and...
"Hah...hngh...ah...hah...!"
A hellish feeling of nausea that makes me gag as if I'm about to throw up my own organs.

page120.text:
...
He stares at me with animosity.
"Wait... What do you think you're doing!? Archer!"
Archer grabbed Tohsaka out of her cage of swords and restrained her.

page121.text:
"Ugh! Hmm! Nnnngh!"
Tohsaka violently moves her body, trying to get away from Archer's grasp.
"Ah...eh...?"
I don't know what he's done, but Archer put his hand on the back of Tohsaka's neck, and her consciousness is gone.

page122.text:
...After that, he decides to leave the church.
He holds Tohsaka in his arms as he leaps up the stairs that lead to the ground above.

page123.text:
"...Where do you think you're going, Archer?"
"To a place that won't be interfered with by anyone.
Besides, I ran out of magical energy. I don't have the strength left to finish that boy when you're protecting him."

page124.text:
"...Why are you taking Rin with you? Is she your hostage?"
"I wouldn't put it like that. As long as she's with me, that boy has no choice but to follow me.
On top of that, Rin is now your Master. You might think highly of that boy but your Master's life is irreplaceable."

page125.text:
...
...I am trying to fight this nausea.
Trying hard to hold on so I don't pass out, I respond to his nonsense.
"...Outside of the town."
And then...
Exhausted, I tell him without even looking at him.

page126.text:
"What?"
"...I just told you, head to the forest outside of the town. There's an abandoned castle and if it's there, we won't bother anyone."
"Shirou...!?"

page127.text:
"You have something you want to say to me, right? Fine, let's hear it.
There are things I want to say to you, too."
I am fading in and out of my consciousness.
Despite the nauseating sickness, I told him as much.

page128.text:
"The forest outside of the town... I see, Einzbern Castle.
Indeed, no one would interfere with us in that castle.
...Hmph, quite a resolve you have there, Shirou Emiya."
"...Shut up. That's not important."
I don't want to hear his flattery.
If I have to listen to any more of it, my innards might burst out of my body from the unbearable pain.

page129.text:
"...I dare you to try to lay a finger on Tohsaka.
If you do, I will kill you even if I have to ask Saber for help."
A sharp pain attacks me.
I warn him in rage and claw at my head to fight my headache.

page130.text:
"Fine. As your reward for the location, I will guarantee her safety for a day.
...But I would advise you to hurry up. I don't have much time since I don't have a Master anymore. I won't last even two days.
If I don't get to kill you before that, who knows? I might kill the hostage out of resentment."

page131.text: ...His annoying laughter lingers in my ear as he leaves.

page132.text:
...
I fell down on my knee before I can see him leave.

page133.text:
"Shirou...! No matter how much you force yourself, even with your skills, it's too early for you to perform the same level of Projection as Archer!"
She holds me as I fall down.

page134.text:
"...I'm sorry, Saber. I let him take Tohsaka."
I try to stand up while holding my head.

page135.text:
"Shirou... Don't worry about that. Rin is fine. I don't think Archer would lay his hand on her.
What you should really worry about is your body. Leave Rin to me, you should just go home and rest."

page136.text:
"...No, we don't have time...for..."
I feel like passing out as I try to finish that sentence.
...Damn it.
I can't believe this. It seems I don't even have strength left to form words.
